items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] George Danahar, your pinks is up there.

ctx.x: Oh, it was an off-made. I bought it from Royal Island. I've forgotten the name, but the reason why I liked it, because they had red, white, and blue on it. It was kind of pretty, you know? And I wanted a pretty banjo, so I got that one.
George Danahar, your pinks is up there.
It was very cheap, but I just liked it because it was pretty to me. I got it, but it wasn't much of a banjo. In fact, it still isn't too good to win. The one I have now is really good.
